keyPoints.en: Grid reference: easting first, then northing (4 figures = square, 6 figures = point).
keyPoints.bm: Rujukan grid: timuran dahulu, kemudian utaraan (4 angka = petak, 6 angka = titik).

keyPoints.en: Bearing: degrees clockwise from north, written with 3 digits (e.g. 045°). Back bearing = ±180°.
keyPoints.bm: Bearing: darjah mengikut arah jam dari utara, ditulis 3 digit (cth. 045°). Bearing songsang = ±180°.

keyPoints.en: Measure curved routes with a string or paper edge, then use the scale.
keyPoints.bm: Ukur laluan berliku dengan benang atau tepi kertas, kemudian guna skala.

keyPoints.en: Contours join points of equal height; the contour interval is the height difference between them.
keyPoints.bm: Kontur menyambungkan titik sama tinggi; sela kontur ialah beza ketinggian antaranya.

keyPoints.en: Close = steep; wide = gentle. Closed rings = hill; V pointing uphill = valley.
keyPoints.bm: Rapat = curam; jarang = landai. Gelang tertutup = bukit; V menghala ke tanah tinggi = lembah.

tip.en: Read contour numbers to see which way the land rises.
tip.bm: Baca nombor kontur untuk melihat arah tanah meninggi.
